CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real first step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler: selfhost/lexer.prn, a faithful PARENA-language port of src/lexer.c, 60 real assertions cross-checked against the C reference. Found and fixed 2 real emitter truncation bugs (emit_if/emit_binop's fixed-size snprintf buffers silently corrupting deeply-nested expressions) along the way. v0.85.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
